author: Acceqted
body:
What is this?
It's almost like an AMA expect all the players have to do is ask for an opinion on them. The creator of the post will then answer honestly.

Why did you create this?

I saw so many comments in AMA's saying "thoughts on my" "opinion." So I decided to create a post just for it.

What do I do?
Just simply do the task of typing "Opinion on me?" And I will answer it honestly. Good luck, and may the answers commence!
